summary: Safety Phase 5 (Closure + Reports Center + Dashboard-v2 + Audit Trail) — 21/21 backend tests PASS + full frontend flow PASS. Closure 15-point checklist works; submit stamps safety_head_approved_at & project_manager_approved_at; override requires >=10 char reason (422 otherwise), Safety-Head/Owner only (403 for sales & site_engineer); reports catalog exposes 32 keys with Excel/PDF export (correct magic bytes); dashboard-v2 returns exactly 29 KPIs; audit-trail list + record_kind filter + /kinds distinct list all work. Frontend: closure page renders 15 chk-* tiles, approve-safety/approve-pm/override-btn/override-reason/override-submit all functional and override chip appears post submission; Reports Center shows 32 rpt-* items, run/xlsx/pdf trigger, search 'incident' narrows to 5 items; Audit Trail table shows 169 rows, filter dropdown to 'hira' narrows to 64; Management Review renders 29 kpi-* tiles and kpi-open_capa navigates to /app/safety/capa, kpi-projects_pending_closure navigates to /app/safety/project-closure. All 13 Phase 1-4 pages still load (200) as regression smoke.
critical_code_review_comments: safety_phase5_router.py at 875 lines is close to the 700-line guideline — consider splitting closure / reports / dashboard / audit into 4 files in a future iteration.

REPORT_CATALOG contains 32 keys but review request labeled it '32 canned reports' — accurate. Report `status` filter uses setdefault which won't override existing extra['status']; acceptable but could be surprising for 'active_permits' etc. — behaviour matches intent.
dashboard-v2 returns 29 KPI keys (review request text says 30 tiles / 29 keys); labelled correctly in frontend as 29.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 safety_project_closures row (via submit + override flows) for first project in DB; harmless to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 fully green.
